request.query: Bounds for powers of three factors from sum of logarithms and floor of a real power

items.name: Nat.pow_log_le_add_one
items.type: ∀ (b x : ℕ), b ^ Nat.log b x ≤ x + 1

items.name: Nat.le_log_of_pow_le
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, 1 < b → b ^ x ≤ y → x ≤ Nat.log b y

items.name: Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, 1 < b → Nat.log b y < x → y < b ^ x

items.name: Nat.pow_le_of_le_log
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, y ≠ 0 → x ≤ Nat.log b y → b ^ x ≤ y

items.name: Nat.le_pow_clog
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (x : ℕ), x ≤ b ^ Nat.clog b x
